latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset contains cerebellar fMRI data from the Multi-Domain Task Battery (MDTB).

Description: 26 unique cognitive tasks and 47 task conditions collected across 4 fMRI scanning sessions. The 5th session includes a resting state scan. 

For a task description,  see task_description.tsv.

Please cite the following reference if you use these data: 
King, M., Hernandez-Castillo, C.R., Poldrack, R.A., Ivry, R.B., and Diedrichsen, J. (2019). Functional boundaries in the human cerebellum revealed by a multi-domain task battery. Nat. Neurosci. 22, 1371–1378.
